caption: The drawing depicts a pewter tankard, rendered in black graphite or pencil on a light beige background. The main object, centered in the composition, is a large tankard with a curved handle on the right side and an outwardly flared spout on the left. The tankard has a domed lid with a thumb lever, and its cylindrical body features two horizontal bands for decoration. The handle has an ornate, sweeping curve. There are two inset sketches: one in the upper left shows the tankard in a simplified elevation view with approximate dimensions marked, and another in the lower right presents a top-down view of the tankard, highlighting its circular lid, central knob, and alignment of the handle and spout. Both inset sketches are outlined and contain thin, precise lines. The artist's name, "BADER," appears in the lower right corner of the page. The shading throughout the main drawing is detailed, providing a three-dimensional effect to the tankard.
title: Pewter Flagon
